workshop_summary: Workshop focused on Dedicated sizing for low-latency chat and reranking. Measured baseline traces, identified two traffic modes (steady 18 QPS; short bursts up to 120 QPS). Recommendation: 6 reserved A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom to add 2 GPUs for peak bursts via burst pool; enable KV prefix caching for product catalog queries to cut token/sec by ~25%. Quantization to int8 + optimized kernels recommended for cost parity. SE noted routing policy: route low-latency trading alerts to H100 pool, lower-priority batch reranks to cheaper q4 variants.
sizing_recommendation_notes: Base reserved: 6 x A100 (or equivalent) sized for 420-token avg, batched throughput.
Burst policy: immediate access to 2 spare GPUs (burst credits) for 10-20 minute windows.
Caching: prefix/KV cache for product-metadata prompts to reduce repeated tokens
Batching config: dynamic batching with 50ms batching window to preserve p95 requirements
Model strategy: primary model quantized 6.7B, fallback 13B q4 for quality-sensitive queries
sla_negotiation_points: Customer requires 99.9% uptime on Dedicated control plane, 99.5% on serving layer during business hours; p95 latency SLOs binding for canary routes; credits tied to missed p95 targets. KMS/HSM attestation and quarterly security audits requested. Proposed compromise: 99.95% control plane, 99.6% serving with remediation credits and 48-hour expedited support path for severity-1 incidents.
